newsitem.title: CHINA: China floods kill 101, shut 10,000 factories.
newsitem.headline: China floods kill 101, shut 10,000 factories.

text.p: Devastating floods have killed at least 101 people in eastern and southern China so far in July and have forced the closure of 10,000 mines and factories in just two provinces, officials and state media said on Monday.
Floods caused by torrential rain had left at least 16 people dead in the central province of Jiangxi, the China News Service said.
Deluges killed at least 10 people in the eastern coastal province of Zhejiang, 41 in the southern province of Guangdong and 34 in neighbouring Guangxi province, local media has said.

The flooding forced 3,000 mines and factories in Jiangxi to stop production, affected 340,000 hectares (840,000 acres) of farmland, destroyed 26,000 houses and damaged 482 km (300 miles) of dykes, the China News Service said.
About 5.59 million people were affected, it said.
In Zhejiang, 7,100 factories were shut due to flooding, a local official said by telephone.
The official estimated direct economic losses in Zhejiang at 3.0 billion yuan ($361 million), with 41,000 houses collapsing and 267,000 hectares (660,000 acres) of farmland flooded.
Floods affected about 5.14 million people in Zhejiang, the official said.
